obsah:
Last weekend we had the chance to test components from our partner Levelsportkoncept.cz – their products are also in our shop www.bikeskills.cz/shop .

Luxurious suspension, pedals and cockpit, on both 27.5" and 29" bikes. We still film videos as amateurs, and the guys filming us had very shaky hands (probably from excitement about the bikes, or something .)), but anyway we enjoyed the ride and let the bikes have a drink of mud.

Besides team riders Mára Tryner, Lukáš Valný (at the time with a dislocated shoulder) and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, guys from our www.mtbtrial.cz club joined in too (the Koudelák brothers, Martin Dostál, Matouš Balík).


Thanks for the loan, www.levelsportkoncept.cz – hopefully next time in a slightly more professional mode. (I'm saving up for a phone with stabilisation.)
